messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Kaitlyn Reed <kaitlyn.reed@outreach.io>, Tim Wu <tim.wu@salesloft.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Staggered renewal proposal for outreach & salesloft seats

Hi Kaitlyn / Tim —

We're coming up on our renewal windows for Outreach and Salesloft and finance has asked us to propose options that smooth cashflow while keeping coverage for the SDR and AE teams. Attached is a quick schedule (proposed-staggered-schedule.xlsx) showing three options: aligned renewals (current), 3-quarter staggered renewals, and full seat consolidation at a single vendor.

Goal for this thread: get formal quotes for the 3-quarter staggered renewal approach and confirm whether Outreach can support split invoicing (quarterly POs that don't change seat counts mid-term) and whether Salesloft can provide prorated billing if we shift seats mid-contract.

Reqs from vendor side:
- Can you confirm acceptance of staggered POs and whether that requires contract amendments?
- Any minimum commitment or penalty for partial-year changes?
- If we move 40 seats from Outreach -> Salesloft during the window, what are the prorate options?

Ben/Marissa/Soojin: please review the attached seat usage CSV; I've called out high-usage teams and seats we think can be flexible.

Thanks — hoping to lock a feasible cadence that avoids a single large payment spike.

Best,
Lauren
Director, Revenue Systems
Redwood Inference

From: Kaitlyn Reed <kaitlyn.reed@outreach.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Outreach Finance <finance@outreach.io>, contracts@outreach.io, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staggered renewal proposal for outreach & salesloft seats

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the clear summary and the schedule. Outreach can absolutely support a staggered renewal plan, but there are a couple of mechanical details:

1) Split invoicing is possible; our finance team prefers quarterly invoices for staggered renewals but will need a signed SOW addendum that lists the PO schedule and seat bands.
2) There is no penalty for moving seats between internal teams, but moving seats off Outreach mid-term typically triggers a prorated credit policy (we provide credits based on unused time on those seats).
3) For moving seats to another vendor, Outreach will require a notice window (30 days) so we can process deprovisioning and final usage reconciliation.

I've asked contracts@outreach.io to draft a short addendum template and attached a sample redline. See also a short note from finance on the invoicing cadence (attached).

Kaitlyn
Enterprise Account Executive, Outreach

Quick internal take after reading Kaitlyn's note:

- Finance will accept quarterly POs but wants the total committed spend across the 12 months to be visible up front for forecasting. I flagged this with procurement (PROC-4521).
- Legal will want the addendum to explicitly state how prorates/credits are calculated.
- For the teams shifting vendors, ops wants at least a 2-week overlap window for seat transfers to avoid gaps.

Soojin — can you confirm if legal needs a specific clause template or if the outreach sample is usually sufficient?

Ben
VP, Sales Operations

From: contracts@outreach.io <contracts@outreach.io>

Cc: Outreach Finance <finance@outreach.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Outreach addendum (draft) + prorate policy

Lauren —

Attached is a one-page addendum template that binds the PO schedule and seat bands. Key points in the draft:
- Staggered POs accepted; each PO covers a 3-month term tied to a seat band.
- Credits are issued monthly for decommissioned seats, calculated as (remaining days / term days) * seat price.
- 30-day notice required for vendor-to-vendor seat migration.
- No change to primary Master Subscription Agreement; this is an addendum.

If you can confirm the exact seat bands you want to commit to for the first year, we can provide firm pricing and a consolidated invoice schedule.

Thanks,
Outreach Contracts Team
(attachment: outreach-addendum-draft.pdf)

Thanks — the draft looks good and matches what finance needs. We're going to proceed on the 3-quarter staggered plan and will provide the seat bands by EOD Monday. Two quick asks before we finalize:

1) Can Outreach confirm whether a consolidated annual forecast (for procurement) can be produced from your side so finance sees total committed spend in one line item? That would help our forecasting while keeping quarterly POs active.
2) Please attach the outreach-addendum-draft.pdf and the sample invoice cadence as separate files in the final package.

Marissa is going to collate the actual seat bands and the current usage CSV and share the finalized schedule. Once we have Outreach pricing for the bands we will submit POs on the quarterly cadence.

Appreciate the quick turn here — this approach should avoid a single large renewal payment while giving vendors the visibility they need.

Best,
